Lean.isProtected.fullDefinition: def isProtected (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Bool :=   protectedExt.isTagged env n
Lean.isProtected.description: A function that checks whether a given name is protected in a specified environment.

Lean.privateToUserName?.fullDefinition: def privateToUserName? (n : Name) : Option Name :=   if isPrivateName n then privateToUserNameAux n   else none
Lean.privateToUserName?.description: A function that attempts to convert a private name to its corresponding user-visible name, if available.
